view-01.png.evidence: Colored fighters are still distinguishable outside the middle of the frame.
view-01.png.regressions: Soft overlapping planes, label, flat discs and square wake swamp the carrier's readability.

view-02.png.evidence: Compact tree shadows keep crowns grounded and the tarmac reads cleanly. Open brackets locate the player among roof edges.
view-02.png.regressions: Aircraft still resembles the hangar roof color at this scale.

view-03.png.evidence: Orange muzzle flashes and thin tracers remain distinguishable among the cream formations and dark wake.
view-03.png.regressions: The upper mission banner partly eclipses the highest aircraft. Dense bow overlap still obscures the pilot.

view-04.png.evidence: Sharp runway and matching small hangars read; shadows help separate vegetation from grass.
view-04.png.regressions: Simple geometry at left and the repeating white water marks are conspicuous; plane is hard to separate from roofs.

view-05.png.evidence: Wing markings remain distinct; quiet smoke allows the deck to read.
view-05.png.regressions: Sea flecks compete with impacts and the nose overlap hides the player shape.

view-06.png.evidence: Aircraft stripes and orange impacts stay distinct against the sea. Open brackets carry ownership across the busy bow.
view-06.png.regressions: Softer silhouettes and top mission-panel overlap cost clarity.

view-07.png.evidence: Large deck and adjacent plane are still identifiable.
view-07.png.regressions: Soft rendering, square wake and centered labels make it resemble a flat icon.

view-08.png.evidence: Brackets sit on either side of the player, with two spaced aircraft against darker water and a dimensional carrier.
view-08.png.regressions: Bow overlap hides some player silhouette. Pale aircraft are visually stronger than the pilot.

view-09.png.evidence: Deck markings and outer carrier shape read at a glance.
view-09.png.regressions: Square wake and hard flat deck contrast with sea and text overlays the bow.

view-10.png.evidence: Market layout and repeated crates frame credible shadows; thin colored paths separate teams in a crowded setting.
view-10.png.regressions: Muted character outfits sometimes blend into the market clutter.

view-11.png.evidence: Airstrip and field pattern remain legible.
view-11.png.regressions: Visible labels obscure the player and low-resolution trees, crops and coast flatten into patches.

view-12.png.evidence: Runway and planted plots remain recognizable.
view-12.png.regressions: Square color patches, faceted trees and target text crossing the aircraft flatten the scene.

view-13.png.evidence: Wet ground, rubble, vehicle shadows and smoke layers form a coherent setting; tracer provides a clear focal cue.
view-13.png.regressions: Dark infantry silhouettes and atmospheric layers reduce immediate readability.

view-14.png.evidence: Strong aircraft shape and color exist outside the central deck cluster.
view-14.png.regressions: Opaque-looking disks, square wake and objective text cover the deck and aircraft.

view-15.png.evidence: Dark navy sea and lightly textured shore frame the blue aircraft; runway, rocks and trees give it scale.
view-15.png.regressions: Blue airframe and lower grey shape almost merge near a rock. Sparse route marks sit close to the coast.

view-16.png.evidence: Warm and cool pools, clean floor-plan edges and distinct objects support tactical paths, sight zones and selected units.

view-17.png.evidence: Vehicle tracks, shadows and fog give a clear slope to a dense believable battlefield; restrained flashes anchor the action.
view-17.png.regressions: Small tanks blend into distant fog and muted earth.

view-18.png.evidence: A lone carrier with a narrow wake is clean against deep textured water. White brackets remain readable at the bow.
view-18.png.regressions: The left bracket reads more cleanly than the bracket over the carrier. Airframe overlaps deck trim.

view-19.png.evidence: Bright cream wings, pinpoint orange impacts and restrained smoke differentiate the main layers of the fight.
view-19.png.regressions: Tight bow overlap and some nearby particles make the subject hard to isolate.

view-20.png.evidence: Bordering aircraft read and translucent particles leave much of deck visible.
view-20.png.regressions: Soft units crowd the ship and inner smoke reads blocky.

view-21.png.evidence: High contrast runway and shoreline with recognizable building shadows and trees. Small bracket marks remain legible.
view-21.png.regressions: The active order card extends over the upper runway area; player and buildings have similar values.

view-22.png.evidence: Runway silhouette and coastline clearly divide the scene; cyan plane edge and smooth surface ripples.
view-22.png.regressions: Trees look detached and terrain plots are softly blurred.

view-23.png.evidence: Runway center line, dark water and tree shadows separate scene surfaces clearly.
view-23.png.regressions: Fallback softness costs some fine object detail. Player is hard to locate against the hangars.

view-24.png.evidence: Airfield composition and painted runway read; facility sides and canopy shadows add depth.
view-24.png.regressions: Player edge is subtle on roof; grass and canopy shapes blur and coast lacks a crisp break.

view-25.png.evidence: Dark wave texture and wake support readable foreground ships and aircraft. Bow brackets signal the subject.
view-25.png.regressions: Bow overlap still makes the blue aircraft difficult to parse.

view-26.png.evidence: Clean deck texture, tower and hull edge give the carrier recognizable volume and a restrained wake.
view-26.png.regressions: Player blends into the deck tip; thin white flecks are spread uniformly across water.

view-27.png.evidence: Explosive bloom and warm cores separate machines from cool foreground; machinery and terrain have rich material detail.

view-28.png.evidence: Peripheral fighters and ship remain identifiable.
view-28.png.regressions: Soft image, overlapping labels, flat burst circles and square wake obscure the center.

view-29.png.evidence: Fine deck linework and wake remain legible. Open brackets carry ownership at the bow without masking its markings.
view-29.png.regressions: The gray-blue airframe still blends into the detailed bow.

view-30.png.evidence: Field stripes and aircraft silhouette are sharp, with small sea streaks.
view-30.png.regressions: Text overlaps aircraft, faceted trees sit on patchy green land, and shoreline is a uniform stripe.

view-31.png.evidence: The clear wake and carrier hull preserve direction even at soft image quality.
view-31.png.regressions: Dark pilot blends into the bow and shadows. Right bracket has lower contrast on the deck.

view-32.png.evidence: Dark textured sea, cream/red aircraft and bright deck edges keep the scene readable. Player brackets leave the bow details visible.
view-32.png.regressions: The mission bar partially covers a high aircraft. Player airframe still competes with the bow markings.

view-33.png.evidence: Brackets surround the wing silhouette next to the sea. Sparse land texture leaves breathing room.
view-33.png.regressions: The tiny cyan aircraft and apparent shadow nearly touch; nearby dark tree shadows are stronger.

view-34.png.evidence: Sharp fighters and raised carrier island with clear deck markings frame the action.
view-34.png.regressions: Mild impact contrast and sea flecks compete for attention; center silhouettes overlap.

view-35.png.evidence: A sharp shore and large crop strips divide land from sea.
view-35.png.regressions: Objective text overlaps player, shoreline has a hard flat border, and field seams are noisy.

view-36.png.evidence: Open brackets frame the player at the shoreline. Compact shadows help even as smaller trees soften.
view-36.png.regressions: The fallback view softens the canopy and aircraft detail.

view-37.png.evidence: Peripheral units and deck outlines stay identifiable.
view-37.png.regressions: Square wake, flat smoke circles and objective labels obscure depth and bow.

view-38.png.evidence: Sharp plane trim and a clear runway corner; trees cast shadows near the distinct land edge.
view-38.png.regressions: Simplified grass patches, geometrical rocks and detached white sea flecks.

view-39.png.evidence: Brackets separate the player from the fleet without another ring. Sharp aircraft stripes and orange impacts keep depth in the swarm.
view-39.png.regressions: The carrier bow and white markings still compete with aircraft, and the mission bar covers some upper silhouettes.

view-40.png.evidence: Stern plume tapers and ring-like player highlight sits apart from peripheral fighters.
view-40.png.regressions: Soft aircraft and deck, prominent wing overlap at the bow, and repetitive water.

view-41.png.evidence: Aircraft and orange spark accents are readable against the dark sea. Brackets avoid filling in the player silhouette.
view-41.png.regressions: The fallback view softens deck edges and a top aircraft remains under the mission panel.

view-42.png.evidence: Clean fleet silhouette with visible deck markings, raised island and tapered wake.
view-42.png.regressions: Player merges with bow; sea ripple is smooth and repetitive.

view-43.png.evidence: Open brackets are easy to recognize against the hangars. Small, compact shadows ground roadside trees.
view-43.png.regressions: Softer texture and the gray-blue palette still reduce separation between plane and roofs.

view-44.png.evidence: Player brackets stay clear of the airframe. Wake and carrier hull stand out in the open water.
view-44.png.regressions: Softer deck markings reduce small-scale clarity.

view-45.png.evidence: Open brackets isolate the aircraft next to the coast. Tighter shadows keep shoreline foliage grounded without dark pools.
view-45.png.regressions: Coast is clear but open field texture repeats.
